title: batchMint discards mint() bool return and totalPaid clamp under-reports caller spend in donation paths
description:
Two related issues:
1. ITokenMinterV2.mint() returns bool success per interface NatSpec; line 78 discards the return (`nftMinter.mint(dispatcherIndex, recipient);`). If a future or alternate dispatcher returns false on soft-failure (e.g., supply-cap reached), the loop iterates count times producing zero NFTs, returns full refund, totalPaid=0 — silent no-op success.
2. Line 86 ternary `paymentAmount > remaining ? paymentAmount - remaining : 0` clamps totalPaid to 0 when remaining > paymentAmount (donation path), under-reporting caller's true net flow to off-chain accounting. Current production dispatcher reverts on failure, making (1) latent. Both are spec/integrator-correctness concerns.
recommendation: Check the bool return value of nftMinter.mint() and revert on false. For totalPaid accounting, either compute it as the actual delta of paymentToken balance pre/post-loop, or document the clamp behavior for off-chain accounting consumers.
